$comment: Generated by design-system/export.mjs from the Paper file below. Do not edit; change Paper and re-export.

--color-window.description: The window behind everything; welcome page

--color-chrome.description: Ground: titlebar gutters and the Project, Papers and Agent navigation

--color-titlebar.description: Titlebar: the shell under a white veil, closed by a hairline

--color-panel.description: The sheet: docked panels and cards

--color-raised.description: The lift: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs, Settings cards

--color-editor.description: Source editor and tool panels (Git, History, Overleaf)

--color-line.description: Hairline: dividers, card edges, segmented track

--color-line-strong.description: Stronger line: secondary Button edge, switch off track

--color-accent.description: Interaction accent (Graphite = neutral); checkbox and switch on

--color-accent-soft.description: Accent wash: menu and picker highlight, compact selected chip

--color-focus.description: Keyboard focus ring (weft blue under Graphite; the accent under a preset)

--color-chrome-hover.description: Hover on the darker chrome, 6% of the ink

--color-row-selected.description: Selected row, 8% of the ink, with medium weight

--color-current-line.description: Editor current line, neutral under every accent

--color-brand-weft.description: Mark weft thread; identity only, never a control

--color-brand-warp.description: Mark warp thread; identity only, never a control

--color-accent-blue.description: Accent preset blue; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-accent-purple.description: Accent preset purple; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-accent-pink.description: Accent preset pink; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-accent-orange.description: Accent preset orange; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-accent-green.description: Accent preset green; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-accent-teal.description: Accent preset teal; its wash is 10% and it is also the focus ring

--color-toolbar-active.description: Toolbar icon that is on, accent 14%

--color-field-border.description: Field, select and search border at rest: ink 12% over the input surface

--color-field-border-hover.description: Field border on hover and focus: ink 24% over the input surface

--color-control-active-border.description: Border of a selected compact chip or card

--color-danger-soft.description: Danger Button rest and danger dialog mark, danger 12%

--color-annotation-highlight.description: Text under an open local note

--color-drop-target.description: Trellis drop slot wash; its edge is the focus colour

--color-nav-text-strong.description: Selected row and typed filter in the navigator, a step under the primary ink

--color-settings-control-hover.description: Settings control hover, ink 5% over the lift

--color-primary-hover.description: Primary Button hover: ink 88% over the app ground

--color-primary-pressed.description: Primary Button press: ink 82% over the app ground

--color-tab-selected.description: Selected panel tab: ink 10% laid opaque on the panel

--color-ring.description: Edge ring of every raised and floating surface

--color-pdf-page.description: A compiled PDF page; paper-coloured in both themes

--color-match.description: Search hit on document content, both themes

--color-syntax-github-ink.description: GitHub code theme (the default): ink: plain code and brackets

--color-syntax-github-line-number.description: GitHub code theme (the default): line numbers in the gutter

--color-syntax-github-caret.description: GitHub code theme (the default): the caret

--color-syntax-github-keyword.description: GitHub code theme (the default): LaTeX commands, keywords

--color-syntax-github-function.description: GitHub code theme (the default): sectioning, functions

--color-syntax-github-type.description: GitHub code theme (the default): environment names, types

--color-syntax-github-variable.description: GitHub code theme (the default): math, variables

--color-syntax-github-string.description: GitHub code theme (the default): strings, arguments

--color-syntax-github-number.description: GitHub code theme (the default): numbers, constants

--color-syntax-github-citation.description: GitHub code theme (the default): citation keys

--font-ui.value: "Inter Variable", Inter, "PingFang SC", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
--font-ui.description: Interface font; release builds put Timeless Sans (Grotesk) first; Chinese sets in PingFang SC. Paper cannot draw Timeless and draws Inter, the closest face it has (glyph overlap 0.73, same width and x-height at the app's 1.04 size-adjust)

--font-display.value: "Instrument Serif", "Songti SC", "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", Georgia, serif
--font-display.description: The one serif voice: Display and Title only, regular weight. Release builds put Timeless Serif first; Chinese falls to Songti SC. Paper draws Lora, the closest face it has to Timeless Serif (same width, x-height 0.98); open builds draw Instrument Serif

--font-editor.description: Code, diffs, logs and every monospace surface. Ioskeley Mono (OFL, bundled with the app) is not installed for Paper, so Paper draws Roboto Mono, the closest face it has (same advance, x-height 1.02)

--font-zh.description: Chinese interface face, the third family in --font-ui

--font-zh-serif.description: Chinese serif, the second family in --font-display

--font-reading.value: "Inter Variable", Inter, "PingFang SC", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
--font-reading.description: Long-form prose: the visual Markdown surface and a paper's title in the reader. Release builds set it in Timeless Serif Text; Paper draws Libre Caslon Text, the closest serif it has (same width and x-height; regular and bold only); open builds use the interface stack

--tracking-caps.description: An uppercase micro label (venue kind, colour picker hex)

--leading-diff-code.description: Diff code, editor font at caption size

--opacity-hover.description: Control hover: ink at this strength

--opacity-tab-selected.description: Selected panel tab: ink at this strength laid opaque on the panel surface

--opacity-tinted.description: Tinted and danger Button rest, status washes

--opacity-disabled.description: Icon buttons, switches and checkboxes when disabled (Buttons use the disabled slab instead)

--breakpoint-narrow.description: Narrow window: secondary footer hints and two-column forms fold

--breakpoint-compact.description: Compact window; a Papers list this wide moves its flags into a right-hand column

--container-settings-control.description: Width of the one control on a Settings row

--container-titlebar-title.description: Longest project name in the titlebar switcher

--container-menu.description: Widest a menu or tooltip grows before wrapping (22rem)

--container-dialog-large.description: Large dialog: Settings, Open from Overleaf, Check references

--spacing-control-compact.description: Compact control: dense chrome, panel headers, toolbars, titlebar

--spacing-px.description: Seam between adjacent segments in one track

--spacing-focus-ring.description: Focus ring width, drawn 2px off the control (offset = same value)

--spacing-dirty-dot.description: Unsaved-changes dot cut out of a tab's file glyph

--spacing-icon-sm.description: Icon in a meta row (status bar) and a disclosure chevron beside a label

--spacing-icon.description: Icon in the chrome: titlebar, panel tabs and headers, compact controls

--spacing-tab-inset.description: A panel tab's side padding; puts its icon on the panel's 20px icon gutter

--spacing-icon-lg.description: Icon on a default control, in a dialog or a toast mark

--spacing-hit-area.description: Smallest pointer target, whatever is painted

--spacing-icon-button-compact.description: Row or field action: toast dismiss, search clear, tab close

--spacing-settings-row.description: Minimum height of a Settings row

--radius-control.description: Anything a pointer lands on: control, row, tab, icon button

--radius-panel.description: Surface: panel, popover, menu, toast, card

--radius-surface.description: Popover, menu, toast and card corner (same step as a panel)

--radius-icon.description: Icon button, row and tab corner (same step as a control)

--ease-fast-cubic.description: Fallback curve where linear() is unsupported

--ease-moderate-cubic.description: Fallback curve where linear() is unsupported

--ease-slow-cubic.description: Fallback curve where linear() is unsupported

--ease-pop-cubic.description: Fallback curve where linear() is unsupported
